items.text: AMEND AND RECOMMIT TO CONSUMER PROTECTION

items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the general business law and the vehicle and traffic law, in relation to requiring the consent of all parties for any transaction involving a motor vehicle where there are multiple purchasers, sellers, or lessees
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S4608

 TITLE OF BILL :  An act to amend the general business law and the
vehicle and traffic law, in relation to requiring the consent of all
parties for any transaction involving a motor vehicle where there are
multiple purchasers, sellers, or lessees

 PURPOSE :

This bill intends to require consent from all people listed on the
title to transfer from the people that own it to any other individual
or entity.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :

Section 3. States that a dealer cannot complete any purchase, lease,
or sale of any motor vehicle without a notarized form with mutual
consent of every party to the transaction. The dealer cannot notarize
the document or anyone directly involved with the transaction.

Section 418. States that there must be proof of consent of all parties
prior to purchase, sale, or lease of a motor vehicle.

Section 418.1 States that a dealer cannot complete any purchase,
lease, or sale of any motor vehicle without a notarized form with
mutual consent of every party to the transaction. The dealer cannot
notarize the document or anyone directly involved with the
transaction.

Section 418.2 States that any purchaser, seller, or lessee injured by
violation of this section may bring an action to recover damages.
Judgement may be entered for three times the actual damages suffered,
or one hundred dollars, whichever is greater. A court also may award
reasonable attorneys' fees to a prevailing plaintiff.

Section 418.3.a States that upon any violation of this section, an
application may be made by the attorney general in the name of the
people of the state of New York to a court having jurisdiction to
issue an injunction, and upon notice to the defendant of not less than
5 days, to enjoin and restrain the continuation of the violation if
the defendant is in violation of this section an injunction may be
issued by the court, enjoining, and restraining, any further
violation, without requiring proof that any person has, in fact, been
injured or damaged thereby.

Section 418.3.b States that a civil penalty of not more than one
thousand dollars for each violation shall be imposed. The attorney
general is authorized to take proof and to make a determination of the
relevant facts and to issue subpoenas in accordance with the civil
practice law and rules.

Section 4.a states that dealer shall submit evidence of the unanimous
consent to transfer the vehicle, including submission of a notarized
document with a signature of all transferors possessing any interest
in the vehicle with such application.

Section 5.2 states that a refund shall not be issued for a vehicle
with multiple owners before notarized proof of consent is provided.

Section 6.1 states that a refund shall not be issued for a vehicle
with multiple owners before notarized proof of consent is provided.

Section 6.2 states that a refund shall not be issued for a vehicle
with multiple owners before notarized proof of consent is provided.


Section 7.k states that the consent of all consumers is need prior to
submissions of an application for a vehicle involving multiple
consumers.

Section 8.v states the notarized proof of consent form...if the motor
vehicle has multiple consumers.

Section 9.1 A dealer shall not refund the purchase price or cancel the
lease for a motor vehicle involving multiple consumer before the
dealer is in possession of a notarized proof of consent form

Section 10.5 states that if there are multiple individuals who signed
for the car, all individuals must indicate their consent before you
receive a refund for the car or have the lease cancelled.

Section 11.3.c stated when there are multiple consumers to the
transaction the dealer shall be in possession of the notarized proof
of consent, before such agreement id executed in order for such
rescission to be valid.

 EXISTING LAW :

There is no existing law covering situations where 2 names are on the
title and one person wants transfer ownership without the other
person's consent.

 JUSTIFICATION :

This piece of legislation simply requires that where a title has two
or more names listed on the title that consent of all names listed is
necessary to transfer the title. A Couple from Brooklyn purchased a
car, they broke up and one party sold the car to a dealership. While
that was taking place, DMV reissued a title to the party solely in
their name, now the case is in civil court and the dealership has a
car they cannot sell because there is no clear title available.

We are trying to avoid situations like this by requiring all people
whose names appear on a title to give consent to transfer a vehicle.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :

New Legislation

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :

None to the state

 LOCAL FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :

None to local

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect on the one hundred eightieth day after it
shall become a law.
